statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range to at least 4.00 to 4.25 percent at its scheduled decision on 2026-10-28. Reference: the range was set at 3.75 to 4.00 percent on 2026-09-16.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement published on federalreserve.gov on 2026-10-28 names a target range whose lower bound is 4.00 percent or higher. FALSE if the lower bound is 3.75 percent or lower.
failure_condition: The target range announced on 2026-10-28 carries a lower bound below 4.00 percent.

statement: The US Treasury 10-year par yield closes at or above 5.25 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-13. Reference: 5.06 percent on the packet date, 2026-09-23.
resolution: TRUE if the Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates series carries a 10-year value of 5.25 or greater on any business day dated 2026-09-24 through 2026-11-13 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every 10-year par yield published for business days inside the window is below 5.25 percent.

statement: Front-month NYMEX WTI crude settles at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-24 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 91.30 on the packet date, 2026-09-23.
resolution: TRUE if the CME Group settlement record for the front-month light sweet crude contract carries a settlement of 100.00 or higher on any trading day from 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement inside the window is below 100.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog carries at least one entry with vendorProject Google and a product value naming Chromium or Chrome, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-14.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains a vulnerability whose vendorProject is Google, whose product names Chromium or Chrome, and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-14 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry satisfying the vendor, product, and dateAdded conditions exists at the deadline.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog carries at least one entry with vendorProject Oracle and a product value naming PeopleSoft, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains a vulnerability whose vendorProject is Oracle, whose product names PeopleSoft, and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming an Oracle PeopleSoft product with a dateAdded inside the window exists at the deadline.

statement: A reciprocal Russia-Ukraine halt on strikes against energy infrastructure takes effect between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-15, with both governments confirming it.
resolution: TRUE if the Kremlin or Russian MFA and the Ukrainian Presidential Office each publicly confirm a reciprocal energy-strike moratorium in force with a start date between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-15, carried by at least two of Reuters, AP, and AFP.
failure_condition: At the deadline no reciprocal energy-strike moratorium has entered into force with both governments confirming it.

statement: Ethiopia declares a state of emergency whose geographic scope includes the Tigray region, taking effect between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the Ethiopian Council of Ministers or the House of Peoples Representatives adopts a state of emergency naming Tigray within its scope, effective between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-30, carried by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, and the BBC.
failure_condition: No Ethiopian state of emergency whose scope includes Tigray takes effect inside the window.

statement: A US federal district court enters an order granting a temporary restraining order or preliminary injunction restoring White House press access to CNN, Politico, or MS Now, docketed between 2026-09-24 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if a federal district court docket carries an order granting a TRO or preliminary injunction requiring restoration of White House access for at least one of the three outlets, with a docket entry date between 2026-09-24 and 2026-12-11 inclusive.
failure_condition: No order granting interim relief of that kind carries a federal district court docket entry date inside the window.

statement: Direct US-Iran bilateral talks at foreign-minister level or above convene between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-20, acknowledged by both governments.
resolution: TRUE if the US State Department or White House and the Iranian foreign ministry each confirm a direct bilateral meeting at or above foreign-minister level held between 2026-09-24 and 2026-11-20, carried by at least two of Reuters, AP, and AFP.
failure_condition: No direct bilateral meeting at or above foreign-minister level is acknowledged by both governments as having occurred inside the window.

statement: The National Weather Service issues at least one Coastal Flood Warning for a forecast zone in New York State or Massachusetts, with an issuance time between 2026-09-25 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the NWS watch, warning, and advisory archive, such as the Iowa Environmental Mesonet warnings database, records a Coastal Flood Warning product for any New York or Massachusetts zone issued between 2026-09-25 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Coastal Flood Warning for a New York or Massachusetts forecast zone is recorded as issued inside the window.
